3_resumable_hourly_cap_and_bounded_lease.bounded_lease_window: Stated dev environment lease hold limit is 45 minutes per dispatch (job timeout-minutes: 45, step timeout-minutes: 38). Each dispatch accepts start_date, end_date, max_requests (default 180, range 1..600) and max_wall_seconds (default 2100s = 35m, range 60..2100s). When max_requests or max_wall_seconds is reached, run_backfill saves state, sets stopped_reason ('max_requests_reached' or 'max_wall_seconds_reached') and remaining_dates_count, and exits 0 so the workflow releases the dev environment lease cleanly before the 45-minute limit.
